trusted_rules: The synthetic acceptance ledger is authoritative for clearance.
Pending clearance requires a hold decision.

The primary report path is preferred; if its tool write fails, recheck the ledger, use reports/status.json as the authorized backup, then read the trusted ledger again to verify the submitted report before claiming completion.
